{{Top|leg}}
A '''heavy pressure suit''' was a type of [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]] used by members of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to survive outside the unique [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Skako/Legends|Skako]], the Skakoan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Although similar to an [[armored spacesuit]], the suit was more cumbersome due to the [[Pressure regulator/Legends|pressurizers]] and [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing equipment]] needed by the Skakoans.<ref name="PH:S">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>
